tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dgongs don rab tu snang bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dgongs don rab tu snang ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra ba kun la mi 'jigs mchog brnyes te/ /mkhas mang 'khor tshogs dbus na seng ge'i sgras/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo legs par bskor mdzad pa/ /zla med ston pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mdo rgyud kun la thub pa'i dbang po dang*/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i don la klu sgrub bzhin/ /rab 'byams 'dul ba'i gzhung la yon shāka dang*/ /rab mtshungs 'jam dbyangs bla ma gtsug na rgyal/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi srid pa'i gar/ /bsam bzhin rnam par rol pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /kun mkhyen bla ma gang de'i bzhed pa bzhin/ /so thar rgya mtsho'i yang snying gsal bar bya/ /de la 'dir rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i don 'chad par byed pa la gsum/ bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag 'chad byed kyi gzhung dgod pa/ /mthar phyin pa'i 'jug gi bya ba'o/ /dang po la yang gsum/ gzhung gzhan 'ga' zhig nas 'byung ba ltar gyi smon pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ don ni/ oṃ ni mchog dang bkra shis sogs don mang po la 'jug kyang*/ 'dir ni tshig phyi ma'i 'go 'dren byed yin la/ de yang 'gro ba thams cad gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba dang*/ mthar thug nges legs thar pa'i gnas su reg par gyur cig ces pa'o/ /spyir mngon mtho nges legs gnyis la'ang bde legs kyi sgra 'jug tu rung bar mngon la/ 'on kyang 'dir gtso bor ni nges legs kyi bde ba la bya'o/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes gsungs te/ don ni/ chos thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pas na/ thams cad mkhyen pa ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang sngon lo paṇa rnams kyis 'dul ba'i sde snod bsgyur ba'i thog mar thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/

mngon pa'i thog mar 'jam dpal dang*/ mdo sde'i thog mar sangs rgyas byang sems la mchod brjod mdzad pa'i bkas bcad dang mthun par bstan bcos 'di 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi khongs su gtogs pas de ltar mdzad do/ /gsum pa dam bca' ba la gnyis/ bshad bya ngos bzung ba dang*/ dam bca' ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ gang la brten nas zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ 'dir gang 'chad par byed ce na/ thabs gang la brten nas bde blag tu ste dka' ba med par nyon mongs pa kun las grol bas na thar pa'i grong ste go 'phang du bgrod par byed nus pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo bde ba gshegs pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa'i snying po mchog tu gyur ba/ mtshan ni srung ba po so sor 'khor ba las thar pa'i byed nus pas na/ so sor thar pa ces bya bar grags pa'i sdom pa gang yin pa de 'dir 'chad do/ /thar pa'i go 'phang ni bde ba'i gnas yin pas grong zhes pa'i ming gis btags kyi khang khyim yod pa'i grong lta bu ni min no/ /gnyis pa dam bca' ba dngos ni/ ngo bo dang ni sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ sngar smos pa'i sdom pa de tshul ji ltar 'chad ce na/ sdom pa de ni ngo bo dang ni/ rab dbye dang*/ so so'i nges 'dzin dang*/ skye ba'i rten dang*/ gtong ba'i rgyu dang*/ phan yon te/ rnam pa drug gi sgo nas ji lta ba bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'chad byed kyi gzhung dgod pa ni/ nges 'byung nas/ 'bad de bsrung*/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ston te/ 'di la drug /sdom pa'i ngo bo bshad pa/ dbye ba/ dngos 'dzin/ skye ba'i rten/ gtong ba'i rgyu/ phan yon no/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nges 'byung bsam pas zhes pa nas/ bzlog pa zhes pa'i bar gsungs te/ sdom pa'i ngo bo ji lta bu yin zhe na de ni/ sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshe mkhan slob sogs kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon gy-i khyad par brda spyad pa las byung ba'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam dag gam/

ma tha bcos ma gang rung gis rgyu byas pa la brten nas skyes shing*/ sems can gzhan la gnod pa gzhi srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa rgyu dang bcas pa las bzlog pa'i dge ba zhig la 'jog go /zhes so/ 'o na/ rgya cher 'grel pa las/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po med par sdom pa mi skye'o/ /zhes nges 'byung gi bsam pa bcos min med par sdom pa mi skye bar gsungs na/ khyod kyis bcos ma la brten nas skye bar yod pa bshad pa ji ltar 'thad snyam na/ /spyir de ltar dgos sam snyam kyang dmigs bsal dus dang bstun te/ rnam rgyal gser mdog las/ sdom pa'i skye rgyu tsam la las mkhan gyis brda sprad pa'i tshe bcos ma'i nges 'byung lhang ba zhig skyes pas go chod kyis mtshan nyid pa skye dgos na deng sang sdom ldan shin tu nyung bar 'gyur la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ zhes pa nas/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ /zhes pas bstan pa de nges 'byung khyad par can la dgongs la 'on kyang*/ mkhan slob kyis brda sprad pa'i tshe/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod dang thar pa thob 'dod kyi blo zhig ni skye dgos shing*/ rje'i gnam rtse lding mar yang de bzhin du gsungs so/ /mkhas grub rjes thub bstan byi dor du/ /gang zag 'ga' zhig la sngon sdom pa len pa'i tshe sdom pa dngos su ma skyes kyang*/ phyis nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshe sngar gyi cho ga la brten nas blang ba'i tshul khrims de sdom par 'gyur par bshad pa ltar 'thad dam snyam ste/ kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis bzhin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ de yang lus ngag las/ zhes pa nas/ rang gi sde pa gong 'og smra/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs te/ sngar bshad pa'i sdom pa de yang 'dod tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ so thar sdom ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi lus ngag gi las su gyur pa'i rnam par rig byed dang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs can gang rung yin zhes 'dod pa'i lugs zhig dang*/

srog gcod sogs spong ba'i sems pa rgyun chags pa khyad par ba dang*/ spong sems de'i sa bon dang bcas pa'ang sor thar gyi sdom pa yin na zhes 'dod pa'i tshul ni rnam pa gnyis yod la/ de yang gang yin gyi 'dod pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas pa rang gi grub mtha' sde pa gong 'og gi smra ba ste bzhed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de gnyis kyi sngon ma gzugs can du 'dod pa ni/ bye brag smra ba/ phyi ma spong sems sa bon dang bcas 'dod pa ni/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa kha cig yin la/ dbu ma thal 'gyur bas lus ngag gi sdom pa gzugs can du 'dod ces gsungs so/ /'di dag rnams la bzhed pa mi mthun pa'i brgal brtag shin du mang yang tshig mang bar dogs nas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis/ rigs brgyad kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ de dag khyim pa dang rab byung gang gi yin bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsnyen gnas sogs rkang pa bzhi'i ston te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de la rigs brgyad do zhes dbyer yod de/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis kyi sdom pa gnyis/ dge tshul pha ma'i sdom pa gnyis/ dge slob ma'i sdom pa/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa dang*/ dge slong ste pha'i sdom pa dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyim pa'i sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ sdom pa de la khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa du/ rab byung phyogs kyi sdom pa du yod zhe na/ khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa ni/ rigs brgyad kyi nang nas/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis kyi sdom pa dang bcas dang po gsum po yin la/ rab byung gi sdom pa ni/ brgyad kyi nang nas/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ dge slong ma/ dge slong pha ma'i sdom pa gnyis dang bcas te/ tha ma lnga po de yin no zhes pa'o/ /sum pa so so'i ngos 'dzin rgyas par bshad pa la drug /bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa/

dge tshul gyi sdom pa/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa/ dge slong pha'i sdom pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sdom pa dngos dang*/ de'i spang bya'i dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba bzhi dang sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis ston te/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gang yin zhe na/ rten gyi gang zag khyim pa gang gis spang bya rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag bzhi ste brgyad nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can spong ba mkhas blangs pa'i sdom pa de bsnyen gnas kyi sdom par zhes 'jog go zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ mi tshangs spyod sogs rkang pa lngas ston te/ 'o na/ rtsa ba bzhi po de gang yin/ yan lag bzhi po de yang gang yin zhe na/ bud med la mi tshangs par spyod pa'i dang*/ gzhan gyi nor ma byin par len pa ste brku ba 'phrog pa sogs byed pa dang*/ mi'am mir chags pa'i sems can gyi srog gcod pa dang*/ mngon shes sogs med bzhin du yod do zhes/ brdzun du smra ba rnams ni/ rtsa ba bzhi yin la/ mal stan gser dngul sogs rin po che las byas pa che ba gru gang las mtho ba dang*/ chang 'thung ba dang*/ gar sogs ste glu gar rol mo sogs rtse mo sgeg chos gzhan dang lus la me tog phreng ba sogs rgyan gsar du 'dogs pa dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas za ba rnams kyi yan lag bzhi yin no/ /zhes so/ /'di dag gi khyad par cung zad rgyas par ni 'og tu 'chad la/ da lta'i khyim pa phal cher gyi srung ba'i sdom pa 'di bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yin kyang*/ len pa'i tshe/ thog mar dge slong sogs gang zag zhig gi drung du blangs nas/ phyis len pa'i tshe gang zag ma rnyed na/ rten gyi drung du skyabs 'gro byas te blangs na skye la/ de yang nang par snga bar lag ris mthong tsam gyi dus zas ma zos gong du len dgos par gsungs kyang*/ da lta'i len tshul sogs la brtags tshe bar ma'i dge ba tsam las tshad ldan gyi sdom pa dka'o/ /'di la yang dpyad par bya ba mang ngo*/

/gnyis pa dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsod brku sogs rkang pa gsum gyis ston te/ khyim pa gang gis srog 'tsho ba'i bar du mi'am mir chags pa gsod pa/ gzhan gyi nor brku bar byed pa/ mi chos bla ma'i brdzun smra ba dang*/ gzhan gyi bud med la log par g.yem pa'i dang*/ yan lag myos 'gyur gyi chang 'thung ba lnga spong bas rab tu phye ba'i sdom pa ni/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'o na/ mi tshangs spyod dang log g.yem la khyad par yod dam med zhe na/ yod de/ khyim pas rang gi bud med la bgrod pa mi tshangs spyod yin kyang log g.yem ma yin/ gzhan gyi bud med la bgrod pa log g.yem dang mi tshangs spyod gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ sna gcig sna 'ga' sogs rkang pa bdun gsungs te/ dge bsnyen de la du yod ce na/ de la rnam grangs kyis drug yod de/ sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs spyod pa dang*/ tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen dang lnga/ de'i steng du skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen bsnan pas/ dge bsnyen rnam pa drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de drug gi khyad par yod de/ rtsa ba bzhi po de las nang nas srog gcod pa lta bu sna gcig tsam spong bar khas blangs pa'i dge bsnyen de sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ de bzhin du ma byin par len pa dang sna gnyis spong pa de sna 'ga' spyod pa brdzun dang sna gsum spong ba de phal cher spyod pa/ 'dod log kyang spong ba de yongs rdzogs spyod pa/ de'i steng du mi tshangs spyod spong ba de tshangs spyod dge bsnyen dang*/ de dag ma spangs kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba tsam gyi sgo nas dge bsnyen du khas len pa skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen du 'jog pa rnams dang*/ go rim bzhin du sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/

/'o na drug po de dge bsnyen dngos yin nam snyam na/ kha che bye brag smra bas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang*/ tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gnyis dngos dang*/ gzhan rnams dge bsnyen du btags pa tsam du 'dod la/ nyi 'og pa dang*/ mdo sde pas thams cad dge bsnyen dngos yin par 'dod ces gsungs so/ /rten gyi sgro nas dbye na pha ma gnyis yod la/ thams cad la skyabs 'gro dang*/ myos 'gyur 'thung ba spong ba gnyis yan lag tu dgos so/ /gsum pa dge tshul gyi sdom pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ spang bya'i khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba bzhi dang sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis ston te/ rten gyi gang zag rab byung gang gis sngar bshad pa ltar rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag drug ste bcu spong bas rab tu phye ba'i sdom pa de/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gar sogs phreng sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis ston te/ sngar bshad pa ltar rtsa ba bzhi'i steng du myos 'gyur 'thung ba/ phyi dro'i kha zas/ mal che mtho/ de'i steng du bsnyen gnas la gar sogs phreng sogs gnyis gcig tu byed dgos kyang*/ 'dir dge tshul la gar sogs dang phreng sogs so sor phye bas rnam pa gnyis dang*/ gser dngul len pa dang rnam pa gsum du phye bas yan lag tu 'gyur zhing*/ de bcu ni dge tshul gyi spang bya'i gtso bo'o/ /bcu po de'i steng du mkhan por gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ khyim pa'i rtags gos dkar sogs ni spong ba dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags stod g.yogs smad g.yogs sogs ni len pa las nyams pa mkhan por ma gsol ba khyim pa'i rtags bzung ba/ rab byung gi rtags spong ba rnam pa gsum ni bsnan pa yis/ dge tshul gyi spang bya bcu gsum dag tu 'gyur ro/ /de'i steng du skyabs 'gro'i mi mthun phyogs bsnan te spang bya bcu bzhir bshad pa'ang yod la/ gzhan yang blangs 'das so drug kyang bshad/

mdor na/ blangs 'das so drug yin kyang*/ phyogs mthun gyi bsdam bya'i dbang du byas na nyes med phyed dang bco brgyad ma gtogs/ gzhan dge slong gis spang byar byed pa thams cad kyang spong dgos par bshad do/ /rten gyi sgo nas dbye na pha ma gnyis yod do/ /bzhi pa dge slob ma'i sdom pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang spang bya'i khyad par so sor bshad pa'o/ /dge tshul sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ dge tshul ma des dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i rjes su lo gnyis gyi bar du rtsa ba'i chos drug dang*/ rjes mthun gyi chos drug spong bar khas blangs pa'i sdom pa ni/ dge slong ma yi sdom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gcig pu sogs rkang pa bcu bzhis ston te/ de yang rtsa ba'i chos drug gang yin/ rjes mthun gyi chos drug gang yin zhe na/ dge slob ma de nyid grogs med par gcig pu lam du 'gro bar mi bya ba dang*/ chu bo'i pha rol tu rkyal byas te brgal bar mi bya ba dang*/ skyes pa dang ni grogs med par lhan cig tu 'dug par mi bya ba dang*/ skyes pa la ni lus kyis reg par mi bya ba dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med smyan du 'gyur ba'i gtam mi bya zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba'i ltung ba byung na 'chab pa ste sbed par mi bya ba de dag ni rtsa ba'i chos drug spong ba'i sdom pa zhes bya zhing*/ zlog phyogs drug ni/ rtsa ba'i chos drug ces bya'o/ /gzhan yang dge slob ma des gser la bzung ba ste reg par mi bya zhing*/ 'doms kyi spu ni breg par mi bya ba dang*/ byin len ma byas par za bar mi bya ba dang*/ gsog 'jog byas pa bza' bar mi bya ba dang*/ rtswa sngon thog tu bshang gci'i mi gtsang ba 'dor mi bya ba dang*/ sa ni brko bar mi bya ba de dag gi zlog phyogs rjes mthun chos ni rnam pa drug spong ba'i sdom pa zhes bya'o/ /des na dge slob ma ni rten bud med kho na yin no/ /lnga pa dge slong ma'i sdom pa ni/

pham brgyad sogs rkang pa bdun gyis ston te/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ brdzun smra ste thun mong pa'i pham pa bzhi dang*/ de'i steng du reg pa'i pham pa/ bkan pa/ 'chab pa/ bzlog pa'i pham pa ste thun mong ma yin pa bzhi ste/ pham pa brgyad dang*/ dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i ltung ba nyi shu dang*/ spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa brgya dang brgyad cu dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba bcu gcig dang*/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te bsdoms na/ spang bya sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa rnams/ spong bar byed pa'i sdom pa de/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa yin zhing*/ gang zag de ni dge slong ma yin no/ /dge slong ma'i ltung ba phal cher dge slong dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba dang gzhan rnams rgyas par gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ kha cig dge slong ma de/ dge slong yin nam ma yin/ yin na/ dge slong pha'i skabs su dge slong ngo zhes gsungs nas/ dge slong ma la dge slong ma zhes dmigs bsal gsungs pa de ci yin zhe na/ de ni dge slong pha la spyi ming bye brag la 'dogs par mdzad kyi dge slong ma dge slong yin te/ dper na/ rta mo de ni rta yin pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang bu mo bu yin kyang*/ bu pho la bu zhes ming 'chags pa ltar/ dge slong ma la yang de bzhin du mtshungs so/ /gal te bu mo bu yin pa ma grub bo snyam na/ de yin par rim lnga gsal sgron las/ rgyud la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi dbye ba'i dper mdzad nas gsungs pas so/ /drug pa dge slong gi sdom pa ni/ pham pa bzhi dang sogs rkang pa bdun gyis ston te/ 'di la yang tshig don mdor bstan pa dang*/ cung zad phye ste rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ pham pa bzhi dang*/ lhag ma ni bcu gsum dang*/ spang ltung sum cu dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags pa bzhi dang*/ nyes byas ni brgya rtsa dang bcu gnyis te khyon bsdoms pa yis/

nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi nyes pa sngar bshad pa de rnams/ spong bar byed pa'i sdom pa de ni dge slong pha'i sdom pa yin cing*/ gang zag de ni dge slong pha zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa cung zad phye ste rgyas par bshad pa la lnga pham pa/ lhag ma/ spang ltung*/ ltung byed/ sor bshags/ nyes byas so/ /dang po la bzhi/ mi tshangs spyod/ ma byin len/ srog gcod/ brdzun tu smra ba'i pham pa bshad pa'o/ /dang por mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa ni/ pho mo ma ning dud 'gro gang gi'ang*/ gson po'am/ lus phyed du longs pa'i ro lta bu'i kha/ bshang lam zag byed gsum po gang rung du/ nor bu bcug cing reg pa'i bde ba rdzogs par nyams su myong ba ste/ sa ga lhas/ kha shun so dang pags pa las/ nor bu 'das na pham pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byis pa sogs kyi lus kyi cha gzhan la brten nas sa bon 'byin pa ni/ dge slong la dge 'dun gyi lhag mar 'gyur zhing*/ pham par mi 'gyur yang*/ yang 'og sgor ni pham par 'gyur ro/ /rab byung kha cig gis pham par mi 'gyur ba tsam la bsam nas/ rang dgar khyim pas shes bzhin du khrel med byed pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rma 'byin pa'i sgo nas nyams par byed par kho na'o/ /gnyis pa ma byin len kyi pham pa ni/ gzhan gyi dngos po rin thang tshang ba rang gis brkus sam/ gzhan la brkur bcug na'ang 'dra la/ rin thang gi tshad ni/ rgya gar du karsha pa ṇa bzhi cha'i tshad yin la/ de la brten nas bod du bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du byung yang*/ lo chen chos skyong bzang pos/ gser se ba bcu'i tshad/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtshos nas khal gcig gam phyed kyis kyang longs pa'i skabs yod par bzhed la/ dang po ltar dngul zho lnga dang*/ spyi ma ltar na dngul zho gsum lhag tsam gyis kyang rin thang tshang bar bzhed la/ 'on kyang 'dul ba mang po'i dgongs par brtags tshe dngul zho gsum longs tsam gyi tshad ri ba zhig ma nor bar rang gi don du brkus sam/

'phrog nas thob pa'i blo skyes pa'i tshe pham par 'gyur ro/ /de yang mis bdag tu bzung pa zhig dang*/ bsam bzhin ma nor bar rang don du brkus pa zhig dgos la/ gzhan don dang brkus sems med par blangs pa sogs yan lag ma tshang na pham par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi mang po'i 'go rgyu'i dngos po brkus na/ so so la ltos pa'i rin thang tshang dgos la/ spyi thabs kyi 'jog rdzas brkus na/ thun mong du rin thang tshang ba tsam gyis chog go /dkon mchog gi rdzas mis bdag tu ma bzung ba bskus na/ mchod rten gyi dkor 'phrog pa'i nyes pa 'byung yang pham pa mi 'byung zhing*/ mi ma yin gyi rdzas sogs mis bdag tu bzung ba gzhan la yang 'dra'o/ /rab byung lha btsun gyis ni gzhan la chad pa bcad pa'i sgo nas 'phrog pa yang rin thang tshang na pham par 'gyur zhing*/ kha cig 'jal byed kyi srang sogs la brten nas ma byin par len pa ni/ ji ltar 'gyur ba gsung rab dang bstun na gsal bar 'chad nus mod/ dus kyi dbang gis smra dka' bar snang ngo*/ /la la mi tshangs spyod ma byas phyir/ gzhan thams cad byas na'ang rab byung du rlom pa de ni/ bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin no/ /gsum pa srog gcod kyi pham pa ni/ mi dngos sam/ ma'i mngal du yod pa'i mer mer po la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyis/ rang gis gsod dam/ gzhan la gsod du bcug kyang pham par 'gyur ro/ /de yang bsam bzhin ma nor bas bsad pa zhig dgos kyi/ gsod sems med par bsad pa sogs la pham pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /'on kyang gsod sems yod na gsod pa'i gzhi ma yin pa 'dra na nor te bsad pa la'ang pham pa 'byung zhing*/ gzhan yang dud 'gro bsad na ltung byed/ mi ma yin pa bsad na sbom po 'byung la/ kha cig rang phugs su bsdad nas gzhan la dud 'gro sogs kyi rigs gsod du 'jug pa ni/ /las 'bras la mgo skor byed 'dod par zad do/ /mdzod las/ dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/

zhes dmag la song ba'i tshe thams cad bsam pa mthun pas gcig gis bsad na thams cad kyis bsad pa dang 'dra bar gsungs la 'on kyang gsod sems med na/ de ltar mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa rdzun du smra ba'i pham pa ni/ mngon shes sgrub rtags sogs med bzhin du yod do zhes smra ba dang*/ lha klu sogs ma mthong bar mthong ngo zhes smra ba lta bu'o/ /lung bstan thogs med du byed pa 'ga' zhig kyang*/ sems bskyed khyad par can gyis zin na ma gtogs 'di'i pham par gtogs so/ /gzhan yang tshong gi phyir sogs la rdzun phran tshegs smra ba ni/ dge slong la ltung byed sogs su 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan la phan pa kho na'i phyir rnam grangs pa'i rdzun smra ba ni/ nyes par mi 'gyur ba mang ste/ drang don gyi mdo bzhin no/ /de dag la bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ mthar thug sogs byed dka' ba mang la/ gzhan yang phyogs mthun tshe rabs dran pa'i sku skye ma yin bzhin du yin zhes dang*/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs bzhin du rdzogs zhes dang*/ dbang lung ma thob bzhin du thob zhes sogs smra ba rnams kyang*/ rang nyid lam log par 'gro ba'i rgyu sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa'o/ /lhag ma sogs ming gi sgo nas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa lhag ma bcu gsum ni/ khu ba 'byin pa'i lhag ma/ reg pa/ 'khrig tshig /bsnyen bkur bsngags pa/ smyan byed pa/ khang pa/ khang chen/ gzhi med/ bag tsam/ dbyen byed pa/ de rjes phyogs pa/ khyim sun 'byin pa/ bka' blo mi bde ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /gsum pa spang ltung sum cu la/ 'chang spang*/ 'bral ba/ zla 'jog / 'khrur 'jug /gos len pa/ slong ba/ slong ba rigs pa/ dpags pa slong ba/ so so nas dpags pa slong ba/ bskur ba ste bcu dang*/ srin bal gyi gdan/ bal nag gi gdan/ cha gnyis bsres pa/ lo drug /mtho gang*/ lam du bal thogs pa/ bal 'khrur 'jug /rin po che la reg pa/ mngon mtshan can/ tshong byed pa ste bcu dang*/ lhung bzed zhag bcu 'chang ba/

lhung bzed lhag po/ thags 'thags tu 'jug pa/ 'thag pa skyed pa/ byin 'phrog /brtad pa las byung ba/ dgon pa'i 'bral ba/ ras chen/ bsngos pa bsgyur ba/ gsog 'jog gi spang ba ste bcu rnams so/ /ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu la/ rdzun smra ba'i ltung byed de/ skyon brjod pa/ phra ma byed pa/ skyon 'dogs pa/ bud med la chos ston pa/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig 'don pa dang*/ gnas ngan len byed pa/ mi chos bla ma bden par smra ba/ shes dor byed pa/ khyad gsod de bcu dang*/ sa bon 'jigs pa/ 'phya ba/ bsgo ba rnar gzon gnas mal dang gding ba las gyur pa gnyis/ spros pa/ phyis gnon/ rtsa ba 'byung ba/ srog chags can gyi chur spyod pa/ rim pa lhag par brtsigs pa ste bcu dang*/ dge slong ma la chos ston pa'i lhung byed/ nyi ma nub nas chos ston pa/ zas kyi ched du chos ston no zer ba/ gos byin pa/ gos byed pa/ lam du 'gro ba/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur 'jug pa/ dben pa skyabs yod na 'dug pa/ 'greng ba/ zas sbyor 'jug pa'i lhung byed de bcu dang*/ yang yang za ba'i lhung byed/ lhag pa gnas te za ba/ lhag pa len pa/ spangs pa za ba/ spangs pa stobs pa/ 'dus shing za ba/ dus ma yin par za ba/ gsog 'jog byed pa/ byin len ma byas pa/ zas gsod pa slong ba'i ltung byed de bcu dang*/ srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la longs spyod pa'i ltung byed/ nyal po byed pa'i khyim na 'dug pa/ der 'greng ba/ gcer bu par zas byin pa/ dmag la blta ba/ dmag nang du gnas pa/ bshams pa/ dkrugs pa/ brdeg pa/ brdeg par gzas pa/ gnas ngan len 'chab pa'i ltung byed de bcu dang*/ zan gcod pa/ mer reg pa/ 'dun pa phyir bsgyur ba/ nub lhag nyal/ sdig lta mi gtong ba/ spangs pa'i rjes phyogs/ dge tshul bsnyil sdud/ kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos gyon pa/ rin po cher reg pa/ khrus byed pa'i ltung byed de bcu dang*/ dud 'gro gsod pa/

'gyod pa bskyed pa/ ga ga tshil byed/ chu la brtse ba/ bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba/ sdangs par byed pa/ sbed pa/ byin pas 'tshol/ skur ba 'debs pa/ bud med dang lhan cig lam du 'gro ba'i ltung byed de bcu dang*/ rkun po dang lhan cig lam du 'gro ba/ nyi shu ma lon par rdzogs pa/ sa brko ba/ mgron du gnyer ba las thag ring 'jug pa/ bslab pa nye bar 'jog pa spong pa/ nyan rna byed pa/ mi smra bar 'gro ba ma gus pa/ chang 'thung ba/ phyi dro grong du 'jug pa'i ltung byed de bcu dang*/ grong du rgyu ba/ rgyal po'i pho brang nub mo 'gro ba/ khyad du gsod pa/ khab ral byed pa/ khri rkang 'chos pa/ shing bal gos pa/ gding ba tshad lhag /g.yan pa dgab pa tshad lhag / dbyar gyi ras chen tshad lhag /chos gos tshad las lhag par byed pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/ /bzhi pa sor bshags ni/ dge slong mar zas len pa/ gral rim ma yin par 'grim du 'jug pa/ bslab pa dral te khyim du 'jug pa nags brtags pa las gyur pa'i so sor bshags te bzhi'o/ /lnga pa nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis las sham thabs kyi bdun ni/ mtha' mnyam par ma bgos pa/ pus mo las brjes pa dang*/ long bu las 'jol ba/ mdun mar lug pa/ mgo thur du lteb par mtho dman byas pa/ ska rags kyi bar na don pa'o/ /stod g.yogs kyi gsum ni/ zlum por ma gyon pa/ yang brdzes pa/ mar 'jol ba'o/ khyim du 'gro ba'i tshe shin tu bsdoms pa lnga ni/ dran shes ma bsten pa/ gos legs par ma gyon pa/ ca co mang du smra ba/ mig phyogs su blta ba/ gnya' shing gang las ring bar lta ba'o/ /mgo g.yog pa sogs lnga ni/ mgo la gos g.yogs pa/ 'dom snang ba/ gzan phrag g.yas g.yon la bkal ba/ lag pa gnya' bar bsnol ba/ ltag par bsnol ba'o/ /'chong ba sogs lnga ni/ mchongs nas 'gro ba/ tsog pus/ rkang pa'i brang gis/ gru mo brkyang ste 'gro ba/ rkang pa brkyang ste 'dug pa'o/ /lus sogs lnga ni/ lus yang yang bsgyur ba/

lag pa bskyod pa/ mgo sgril ba/ phrag pa sprod pa/ lag pa sbrel ba'o/ /'dug pa dgu ni/ ma bskos par stan la 'dug pa/ ma brtags par 'dug pa/ khri la lus kyi ljid 'gel ba/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol nas brkyang ba/ brla gnyis bsnol ba/ long bu bsnol ba/ rkang pa khri 'og tu bkug pa/ rkang mgo phyir gdengs pa/ 'dom snang bar byed pa'o/ /zas len pa brgyad ni/ zas legs bar ma blangs pa/ mu dang kha da chang du blangs pa/ 'bras tshod ma mi mnyam par len pa/ mthar chags su mi len pa/ ma bltas par len pa/ zas ma byung bar lhung bzed gdangs pa/ gcig gis gcig sbas pa/ bza' bca'i steng du lhung bzed bzhag pa'o/ /zas za ba la legs par bya ba sogs drug ni/ legs par ma zos pa/ kham ches pa/ chung ba/ ran pa ma yin pa/ kha gdangs pa/ zas kyis kha gang bzhin gtam smra ba'o/ /za ba'i tshe tsug tsug sogs lnga ni/ khar tsug tsug /cag cag /hu hu/ phu phu zer ba dang*/ lce phyir phyung nas za ba'o/ /tha dad byed pa sogs lnga ni/ 'bru re re nas za ba/ zas la smod pa/ phan tshun spo ba/ kham rkan sgra tog pa/ kham 'phro ba gcod cing za ba'o/ /bldag pa sogs lnga ni/ lag pa bldag pa/ lce dang mdzub mos 'khyog pa/ lag pa sprug pa/ lhung bzed skyom pa/ zas mchod rten ltar bcos nas za ba'o/ /lhung bzed la 'phya ba sogs bzhi ni/ gzhan gyi lhung bzed la 'phya ba/ zas bgos pa'i lag pa chu snod 'dzin pa/ sbags pa'i chu 'thor ba/ khyim du khrud chu 'bo ba'o/ /lhag ma blug pa sogs bcu ni/ lhag ma lhung bzed du blug nas 'dor ba/ lhung bzed sar 'jog pa/ g.yang sa gad kha dkan gzar du 'jog pa gsum dang*/ de gsum du bkru ba gsum dang*/ 'greng ste bkru ba/ chu rgyun las bzlog pa ste bcu'o/ /chos bshad pa la 'greng ba sogs lnga ni/ yangs pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ mtho sar bsdad pa dang*/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ lam gyi 'gram sogs na gnas pa la chos bshad pa'o/ /mgo g.yog sa sogs lnga ni/

mgo la gos g.yogs pa/ gos brjes pa/ phrag gong gnyis su gzar ba/ lag pa gnya' bar bsnol ba/ ltag par bsnol ba sogs la chos bshad pa'o/ /do ker sogs lnga ni/ skra'i thor cog byas pa/ cod paṇa bcings pa/ zhwa gyon pa/ thod bcings pa/ phreng bas brgyan pa la chos bshad pa'o/ /glang chen sogs lnga ni/ glang po/ rta/ de ma yin pa'i bzhon pa/ mdo lis btegs pa/ mchil lham gyon pa sogs la chos bshad pa'o/ /'khar ba sogs drug ni/ lag na 'khar ba/ gdugs/ mtshon cha/ ral gri/ mda' gzhu thogs pa/ go cha gyon pa sogs la chos bshad pa'o/ /bshang gci 'dor ba sogs bzhi ni/ /'greng ste bshang gci 'dor ba/ chu la de 'dor ba/ rtswa sngon du de 'dor ba/ shing 'doms gang yan chad la 'dzeg pa'o/ /de ltar na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum ste/ phal cher ming gi sgo nas bshad la/ thams cad ngo bo'i sgo nas phye ste rgyas par bshad na mang bar dogs nas ma bris so/ /bzhi pa skye ba'i rten ni/ de ltar so thar rigs brgyad po/ /zhes sogs rkang pa lngas ston te/ sngar bshad pa de ltar so thar rigs brgyad po de rnams rten gang la skye na/ de dag gling bzhi'i nang nas byang gi sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa'i gling gzhan gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med tshad ldan gyi rten la skye yi/ 'on kyang pho mo'i rtag snga tshad ldan med pa'i za ma dang zla ba stod smad la pho mor res mos su 'gyur ba'i zla phyed ma ning dang 'khyud pa'i tshe ldang ba'i 'khyud ldang ma ning sogs ma ning dang*/ pho mo'i mtshan gnyis mnyam por byung ba'i mtshan gnyis dang*/ sogs sgras lha dang mi ma yin pa'i gang zag de rnams kyi rten la sdom pa de skye ba min no/ /de yang tshe de thog nas de dag gi rgyud la sdom pa de mi skye ba'i don yin gyi/ de rnams kyi rgyud la gtan nas mi skye ba ma yin te/ de'i rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes skye bar khas len dgos pa'i phyir ro/

/lnga pa sdom pa de gtong ba'i rgyu la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu la gnyis/ zhes gsungs te/ lngar bshad pa'i sdom pa de rnams gtong bar byed pa'i rgyu la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ /thun mong pa'i gtong rgyu dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gtong rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ bslab pa phul dang sogs rkang pa gsum gyis ston te/ rang gi gang blangs pa'i bslab pa de mi srung ba'i ched du gzhan la slar phul ba dang*/ shi 'phos te tshe'i dus byas pa dang*/ pho mo'i mtshan gnyis cig car du byung ba dang*/ mtshan lan gsum du gyur pa dang*/ logs lta sogs kyis dge rtsa chad pa rnams kyis sdom pa gtong bar 'gyur pas/ de dag sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu thun mong ba yin no/ /'on kyang 'tshang mi rgya ba'i sems can yod par 'dod pa'i lugs la dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag yod kyi/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa rnams kyis ni dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag mi 'dod de/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyu la sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyis khyad par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gtong rgyu thun mong ma yin pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ kha cig 'dod bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nyi shu ma lon sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ lo nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ phyis lo nyis shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa skyon yin par shes pa'i tshe/ lo nyi shu lon na sdom pa mi gtong yang*/ nyi shu ma lon na der 'du shes skyes pa dang*/ skyes pa dang lhan cig 'dod pa bsten pa'i phyir khas blangs pa dang*/ nyin zhag gcig po de 'das pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin du ste/ dang po ni/ dge slong gi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu dang*/ gnyis pa dge slong ma dang*/ gsum pa bsnyen gnas rnams kyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/

sde pa gzhan gyi 'dod pa dang*/ bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba sogs rkang pa gsum gyis ston te/ mdo sde pas/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung bas sdom pa gtong ba dang gos dmar sde pas dam pa'i chos nub pa las/ so thar gyi sdom pa gtong zhes 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha che bye brag smra ba sogs rkang pa gsum gyis ston te/ bye brag smra ba la kha che ba dang*/ nyi 'og pa gnyis yod pa las/ kha che bye brag smra ba rnams kyis sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung ba la sdom pa yod pa dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal pa gnyis ka yin par 'dod de/ dper na/ mi 'ga' zhig bu lon kyang 'jal dgos pa dang nor dang yang ldan pa bzhin du 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /de la so thar gyi sdom pa rnams rkyain de lta bu byung na gtong yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ gzhan gsang sngags kyi sdom pa sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mi gtong ba mang ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa rnams tshe gcig gi thog dang*/ gzhan gnyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du len pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa phan yon bshad pa la gnyis/ phan yon dngos dang*/ gdams ngag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdom pa de dag sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ sngar bshad pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa de dag gang zag gang gis bsrungs ba'i phan yon yod de/ de ltar bsrung ba la brten nas/ gnas skabs su 'bras bu mngon mtho lha dang*/ mi'i go 'phang rgyud mar thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bus nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub gsum po gang rung ba zhig thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gdams ngag ni/ brtson ldan sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis ston te/ sngar bshad pa'i phan yon de ltar yod pa'i rgyu mtshan des na/

brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams kyis so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dus rtag tu gus pas 'bad de bsrungs par byos shig/ces gdams so/ /gsum pa mthar phyin pa'i 'jug gi bya ba ni/ dge des sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis ston te/ don ni/ de ltar so thar gyi mdo'i gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba des skye ba nas skye bar lus can sems can rnams dus rtag tu tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa la gnas par shog ces pa'o/ /mdzad byang ni/ ces so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gtan la dbab pa zhes gsungs te go sla'o/ /de yan chad kyis gzhung don dngos rdzogs nas/ 'phros don nam/ zhar byung gi tshul du 'ga' zhig gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du bshad par bya'o/ /'dir dge slong gis bsrung bya ni/ lus ngag gi kha na ma tho ba mtha' dag srung dgos kyang*/ lhag tu rtsa ba bzhi bsrung ba dang*/ yo byad bcu gsum dgos la/ khyad par chos gos gsum po tshang dgos te/ chos gos gsum ni/ rnam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos gsum yin la/ de la rnam sbyar gyi tshad ni/ dpangs su khru gsum dang*/ srid du khru lnga che tshad dang*/ chung tshad dpangs su khru do dang*/ srid du khru bzhi/ de'i bar 'bring ngo*/ /de bzhin du bla gos la yang 'dra'o/ /mthang gos gi dpangs su khru do/ /srid du khru lnga 'am bzhi'o/ /ral kha dpung chad tshad las mi gtogs so/ khru la lus khru dang*/ lag khru gnyis las/ 'dir rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar cha bdun du byas pa'i cha gnyis la khrur byas pa'o/ /byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yul de/ bslab pa rgan na phyag bya/ min na mi dgos/ chos gos gsum po gang yang rung ba zhig bzhi bltab byas pa'i sne mo gcig rang gi phrag pa g.yon par bka'/ sna mo gcig gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ g.yas pas mnan nas/ gnyis ga 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/

/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung bar spyod pa 'os pa 'di/ chos gos rnam sbyar sogs su byin gyis brlab po/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas thabs legs bya'o/ /sngon du thugs gtad zhu ba dang*/ rjes su bka' drin zhu ba gnyis 'ga' zhig na yod la/ phal cher na med pas nges par dgos pa min kyang*/ de ltar byas na'ang legs pa min no/ /yo byad lhag mas gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /da lta kha cig la snam sbyar lta zhog /mthang gos kyang med pa mang du snang la/ chos gos rnam gsum la dmigs bsal gyi skabs 'ga' zhig yod kyang*/ mthang gos gtan nas med pa dang*/ yod kyang sham thabs tsam gyon pa de dag gis ni/ ma 'ongs pa na thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun 'di la/ dge slong rnams chos gos rnam gsum gang yang mi dgos pa'i grwal du 'jug pa'i rkyen byed par 'gyur bas/ thub bstan la mi phan na'ang*/ gnod mi 'dod pa de dag gis 'byor na chos gos rnam gsum dang*/ med na'ang bla gos mthang gos gnyis nges par bzung zhes zhu'o/ kha cig bla gos tsam sdom pa yin par 'dzin pa ni/ rmongs pa yin pas lan med do/ /sman la rigs bzhi yod kyang*/ dus rung gi zas ni/ bza' ba la/ 'bras chan/ zan/ sha /'khur ba skyo ma/ 'o 'dzar/ zho/ dar ba/ thug pa rnams yin la/ de rnams dus min du zar mi rung la/ bca' ba ni/ rgun 'brum/ kham star/ la phug sogs kyi lo ma rnams kyang dus rung gi zas yin la/ zho sogs dang kham star sogs la mi 'dzem pa mang du snang ngo*/ /zas gang yin kyang rang gi za ba'i ched yin na byin len dgos pa dang*/ kha bshal ba'i chu byin len mi dgos kyang*/ skom pas 'thung rgyu yin na/ byin len dgos par thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtshos bzhed do/ /byin len 'chags tshul dang*/ 'jigs pa'i tshul mang len pa po dang stob pa po'i bar na/ rdo/ shing*/ gos sogs zheng dpang sor bzhi yan dang*/ dkyus khru gang man gyis bar chod na mi 'chags shing*/

'on kyang cog rtse sogs byin len nod pa'i gzhi'i steng du 'chags par rnam rgyal gser mdog sogs nas bshad la/ zas de la bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa gzhan gyis reg pa byin len 'jig pa'i rgyur gsungs kyang*/ rgyang nas 'gul ba tsam 'jig pa'i rgyur ma bshad cing*/ bshad na khang pa 'gul ba yang byin len 'jig pa'i rgyur thal ba 'gyur ro/ /snyam mo/ /lhag tu yang chang 'di srog la bab kyang mi gnang bas btung bar mi bya ste/ lung las/ nga la ston pa zer ba khyed cag gis chang ni rtswa'i rtse mos kyang btung bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ sman pa'i ngag gis btung bar ni/ srog la phab kyang ma gnang ste/ zhes dang*/ chang 'thung ngu 'bod gnas su skye/ ldud mkhan de yi 'khor du skye/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtshos rnam rgyal gser mdog tu /tha ma kha ri grags pa'i sngo 'di/ lo rgya lhag tsam nas rgya gar dang rgya nag tu byung zhing*/ de yang bud med gcig gis smon lam log par btab pa'i khrag sa la lhung ba las skyes shing*/ byed rkyen gyis 'byung po snying la zhugs nas du ba rngub dgos pa'i gang la yang phan pa chung zhing*/ nad sogs mang du bskyed pas dgag bya che ba khyad par bag med pa'i gnas su sbyor ba la chang dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dzem dgos la/ kha cig dge 'dun dang gtsug lag khang gi dbus su 'then pa ni de'i dbus su phyen tang ba las kyang ngan no/ /gzhan yang*/ gsang sngags kyi nang mchod kyang bdud rtsi yin pa'i 'du shes kyi 'thung na ma gtogs/ chang btung 'dod kyis 'thung na sngar bshad pa'i nyes pa las mi 'da'o/ /chab kyang de dag yan lag tsam ma gtogs gtso bo min yang*/ zas za ba'i sngon 'jug tu len dgos par thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtshos gsungs la/ dri chen dri chu 'dor ba'i rjes dang*/ zas zos pa'i mjug dang kha 'don gyi sngon du byed pa mkhas pa dag gis phyag len du snang zhing*/

de yang dri ma 'khru ba'i don du byed dgos la/ kha cig rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang bral zhing khyim pa'i rtags dngos su 'dzin pa de dag gis ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyams par byed par nges la/ yang kha cig mi dge ba bcu tsam yang spong dgos pa'i skad cha med par gzan sham chab ril tsam 'dzin cing 'tsho ba sgrub pa la mkhas pa tsam la blo gtod pa ni/ ches cher 'khyams pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra zhing phra ba tsam du ma zad/ rags pa tsam yang da lta dus dbang gis dka' bar 'jug kyang*/ ma tha rtsa ba bzhi srungs ba gal che zhing*/ rtsa bzhi gang rung shor na tshul khrims 'chal la/ tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur na dad pa can gyi zas sogs shin du 'ju bka' ba yin te/ sa ga lhas/ mi slob pa ni bdag sor spyod/ slob pa byin pa spyod pa ste/ bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa ni/ rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/ lhag ma le los bcom pa yis/ /bdag nyid la ni bu lon sbyong*/ khrims 'chal rnams ni nam du yang*/ gtsug lag khang sogs nyer spyod bkag /zhes gsungs ba'i phyir ro/ /mdor na theg pa gsum gyi bcas pa mtha' dag rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin du blangs nas de'i gzhung bzhin slob pa dang*/ nyes pa byung na'ang de'i skabs bzhin bshags pa dang*/ phyir bcos byed dgos kyang*/ da lta ni de ltar byed pa nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon pa'i dus tha ma 'di lta bu la/ de ltar byed mkhan byung na mi mang dang mi mthun na'ang*/ dgra bcom dang 'dra bar bdag gi yid kyis phyag bya'o/ /'on kyang dus gsum du'ang*/ nyin re bzhin du dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du bshags pa sogs bsam pa thag pas ma byas na/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis gsungs pa ltar lam gang du 'gro mi shes so/ /gal te de dag las gzhan gyi thugs la 'phog pa'i tshig 'ga' zhig byung na bzod par mdzod cig dang*/ kho bos ni rang gi ma tshad thub pa'i gsung dang bstun te smras pa yin gyi/

gzhan gyi skyon bsgrags pa ma yin la/ de la brten nas rgyal ba'i gsung dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig byung na/ de ni thub bstan yun ring gnas pa'i phyir bsngo'o/ /smras pa/ rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /yang nas yang du legs par rab bsngags pa/ /mngon mtho mngon par 'grub pa'i rgyu yi gtso/ /tshul khrims tshul bzhin srung rnams skal ba bzang*/ /'on te thub bstan lnga brgya phrag drug par/ /gsungs kyang 'ga' yi spyod tshul la brtags na/ / rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus dang nye bo snyam/ /mya ngan yid kyi phug nas mchi ma 'khrugs/ /gzhung lugs ma thos ches cher blun po rnams/ /log lam gol bar 'khyams pa bden mod kyi/ /rnam dpyod mig can bdag dang bdag 'dra 'gas/ /rgyal stan sun 'byin byed pa skal ba dman/ /'jam dbyangs rje btsun bla ma'i dgongs pa mchog /mchog tu dag pa'i yid kyis bkral ba 'di/ /'di dang phyi mar rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /kun mkhyen dgongs pa bzhin du 'dzin pa'i rgyu/ /de lta na'ang khron pa'i rus sbal bzhin/ /rang gis cung zad rtogs pa'i mig gcig gis/ /gzhung don log par bkral ba 'ga' srid na/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar nges par 'chags/ /gzhung lugs 'chad la ljags kyi rtse thung yang*/ /gzhan gyi skyon sgrogs mi dge'i gtam smra bar/ /log pa'i shes rab rgyas pa'i skye bo 'gas/ /yin min smra yang bden min rdzun pa'ang min/ /tshul 'dir 'bad las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ /tshul bzhin legs par bshags pa gang yin des/ /tshul khrims 'dzin pas sa steng kun gang zhing*/ /tshul des thub bstan yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab la cung zad sbyangs yang*/ gsung rab dang zhus dag byas pa'i tshe mi mthun pa mang ba rab 'byams smra ba khas 'che zhing*/ thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyi drin chen gyis 'tsho ba co ne'i shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/

sngar rang lo so dgu pa rnam rgyal zhes pa chu sbrul lor bgyis pa ste/ phyis dad dang rnam dpyod rgyas pa'i gur chen dka' bcu ba 'jam dbyangs bzod pa nyid klu chung khri thog tu yod dus gzhan la phan 'dogs kyi thugs bskyed bzang por par du bsgrubs pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring du gnas par gyur cig / bkra shis dge legs 'phel// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dgongs don rab tu snang bar byed pa'i sgron me bzhugs/ -PAGE 320--PAGE 321--PAGE 294-
